review_description: The quoting process went well with options of just replacing the inverter and /or upgrading with bigger wattage panels explained. They confirmed we were better off retaining our 1.5kw system and FIT rather than a larger system.  They also explained with a 3 phase system we can add another bigger PV system and maybe batteries at a later date when the current FIT expires.  Installation was quick and on the appointed day, no mess to clean up.  Some broken tiles were replaced,  Communication with the energy supplier was all organised and connection to the grid completed same day!  An email from the invertor every morning with the previous day's production appreciated! All good!
